concepts.name: Горизонт событий
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original finished app icon concept for Изbrainое, a personal memory and saved-files app. Pure monochrome, white mark on flat near-black square background. Centered composition, symbol occupies about 65% of the square with generous safe margins. Sophisticated contemporary brand design, crisply rendered vector-like shapes, small-size legibility. No mockup, no scene, no 3D material, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no gradients into colors, no watermark. This is one distinct concept, do not combine unrelated astronomy subjects. Subject: A black hole seen nearly edge-on: a perfectly black circular void, a luminous WHITE accretion ribbon crossing horizontally in front, one gravitationally lensed white arc curving above the void. The silhouette itself is the logo. Bold compact proportions, scientific inspiration turned into an original memorable brand mark. Absolutely no stars, planets or galaxy arms.
